Release Bot: Heads-up: release train update for this week — freeze starts Wed 09:00 UTC. No non-critical feature merges after Tue 23:59 UTC. Exceptions: critical security patches and DB migrations with approver sign-off. :warning:
Alex Kim: Got it. Does the freeze apply to Dedicated rollout calendars or just hosted?
Release Bot: Applies to all release lanes (hosted, dedicated, private). If you need a carve-out, ping @DevOps with the risk assessment.
Jordan Patel: Quick status: canary for inference-runtime v3.14 is at 12% in us-west, p50 latency +4ms, error rate flat. Rolling metrics in the dashboard: /releases/canary/ir-3-14
Maria Gomez: FYI SLO alarms triggered once overnight for kv-cache pressure on a small subset. We applied a temporary throttling rule at 03:12 UTC. Watching.
Samir Rao: For the console change (feat: route-level tracing), can we hold the client-side rollout until after freeze? It has a wider blast radius.
Alex Kim: Agreed — postpone console client rollout. Keep server side patch only.
DevOps: Noted. Canaries continue but no widening of percent during freeze without explicit approver. To request override, add a short PR comment with the approver's GitHub handle and a one-line rationale.
Jordan Patel: Two small asks — (1) please ensure embedding-service quantization job is not scheduled during Wed 08-12 UTC maintenance window, (2) will we still do nightly evaluation runs?
Release Bot: (1) DevOps — embeddings quant job is paused for Wed 06-14 UTC per request. (2) Nightly evals continue but results are gated; no automated rollouts from evals during freeze.
Maria Gomez: Rollback plan reminder: if canary error rate > 2x baseline for 10m OR p95 latency regresses > 25% run the automated rollback: `./ops rollback --train inference-runtime --to previous` and @DevOps will be paged.
Alex Kim: Thanks. I'll coordinate with product for any last-minute critical fixes. :thumbsup:
Release Bot: TL;DR: freeze Wed 09:00 UTC -> Mon next week 09:00 UTC, canaries allowed but no percent increases without sign-off, emergency exceptions via @DevOps. Post any exceptions in this thread.
